theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [Archimedean α] (f : α →+*o α) : f = OrderRingHom.id α := by
  -- Step 1: Show f(1) = 1
  have h1 : f 1 = 1 :=
    by
      rw [OrderRingHom.one_eq_one]
      exact (ring_hom.map_one f).symm

  -- Step 2: Show f preserves positivity
  have h2 : ∀ x : α, 0 < x → 0 < f x :=
    by
      intro x
      intro hx
      apply OrderRingHom.positive_map
      exact hx

  -- Step 3: Use Archimedean and order preservation to show f is identity
  have h3 : ∀ x : α, f x = x :=
    by
      intro x
      cases x with x'
      · simp only [OrderRingHom.id_apply, zero_eq_zero]
      · rcases eq_or_lt_zero x' with h | h
        · rw [h] at h2
          rw [h] at h1
          have : f x' = x' :=
            by
              have : f x' = f (x' - x') + f x' :=
                by rw [add_right_cancel_iff]
              rw [add_right_cancel_iff]
              have : f x' - f x' = 0 := by rw [sub_self]
              rw [this]
              have : f (x' - x') = f x' - f x' := by rw [ring_hom.map_sub]
              rw [this]
              have : f (x' - x') = 0 := by rw [sub_self]
              rw [this]
              have : f x' = x' :=
                by
                  have : f x' = f (x' / 1) := by rw [div_self]
                  rw [ring_hom.map_div]
                  rw [h1]
                  exact rfl
              exact this
        · have : 0 < x' := h
          have : 0 < f x' := h2 x' h
          have : f x' = x' :=
            by
              have : f x' = f (x' / 1) := by rw [div_self]
              rw [ring_hom.map_div]
              rw [h1]
              exact rfl
          exact this

  -- Step 4: Conclude f = id
  exact funext h3
